topLevelNodes.name: KETAKI HARIDAS . CONTEMPERORY TREND IN USER EXPERIENCE DESIGN

I graduate today with a degree in design. Ten years later, I enter a design studio. But the studio has changed. AI agents can: • Generate 100 interface concepts in seconds. • Build functional prototypes instantly. • Conduct thousands of simulated usability tests. • Write production-ready code. • Create and maintain design systems. • Analyze user research and identify patterns. • Personalize experiences for every individual user.
